title: Implement polyphase FIR oversampling engine with PDC latency reporting
description:
Create Source/DSP/OversamplingEngine.h and Source/DSP/OversamplingEngine.cpp implementing a polyphase FIR half-band oversampling engine wrapping juce::dsp::Oversampling<float> for 1x, 2x, and 4x rates. The engine allocates all oversampling stages during prepare (never inside processBlock), exposes upsample/downsample entry points returning the oversampled AudioBlock, and reports processing latency through getLatencySamples() so the processor can call setLatencySamples. Follow binding rule (1): no heap allocation, locks, or buffer resizing on the audio path; all buffers allocated during prepare. STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/ for existing DSP module header/cpp conventions and namespace usage
- CMakeLists.txt for JUCE module linkage (juce_dsp) already available to the target
- JUCE/modules/juce_dsp/processors/juce_Oversampling.h for the Oversampling<float> API (read only; do not modify anything under JUCE/)
- PluginProcessor.h/.cpp (if present) for prepareToPlay and setLatencySamples usage patterns
acceptance_criteria: OversamplingEngine supports 1x, 2x, and 4x factors and exposes a getLatencySamples() accessor for PDC reporting
All oversampling stages are allocated in a prepare method; no allocation, locking, or buffer resizing occurs on the audio processing path
cmake --build build --target ShredBoost compiles OversamplingEngine.cpp without errors
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: allocate memory, lock, or resize buffers inside the audio processing path
